post.caption:
The East India Company began with a trading licence and ended with an army larger than Britain's. The mechanism is the interesting part: trade needs warehouses, warehouses need guards, guards need forts, forts need land. After Plassey in 1757 it won the right to collect tax across Bengal, so a private company was funding its own army from the taxes of the people it governed. Commercial leverage converting into governance, then into extraction.
